method: Actual native density volume, zero emission/blackbody. Local preview shading lights only, no production pass.

name.description: Unique data-block ID name (within a same type and library)

name_full.description: Unique data-block ID name, including library one if any

session_uid.description: A session-wide unique identifier for the data block that remains the same across renames and internal reallocations, unchanged when reloading the file

is_evaluated.description: Whether this ID is runtime-only, evaluated data-block, or actual data from .blend file

original.description: Actual data-block from .blend file (Main database) that generated that evaluated one

users.description: Number of times this data-block is referenced

use_fake_user.description: Save this data-block even if it has no users

use_extra_user.description: Indicates whether an extra user is set or not (mainly for internal/debug usages)

is_embedded_data.description: This data-block is not an independent one, but is actually a sub-data of another ID (typical example: root node trees or master collections)

is_linked_packed.description: This data-block is linked and packed into the .blend file

is_missing.description: This data-block is a place-holder for missing linked data (i.e. it is [an override of] a linked data that could not be found anymore)

is_runtime_data.description: This data-block is runtime data, i.e. it won't be saved in .blend file. Note that e.g. evaluated IDs are always runtime, so this value is only editable for data-blocks in Main data-base.

is_editable.description: This data-block is editable in the user interface. Linked data-blocks are not editable, except if they were loaded as editable assets.

tag.description: Tools can use this to tag data for their own purposes (initial state is undefined)

is_library_indirect.description: Is this ID block linked indirectly

library.description: Library file the data-block is linked from

library_weak_reference.description: Weak reference to a data-block in another library .blend file (used to re-use already appended data instead of appending new copies)

asset_data.description: Additional data for an asset data-block

preview.description: Preview image and icon of this data-block (always None if not supported for this type of data)

texture_slots.description: Texture slots defining the mapping and influence of textures

is_fluid.description: Particles were created by a fluid simulation

use_react_start_end.description: Give birth to unreacted particles eventually

show_unborn.description: Show particles before they are emitted

use_dead.description: Show particles after they have died

use_emit_random.description: Emit in random order of elements

use_even_distribution.description: Use even distribution from faces based on face areas or edge lengths

use_die_on_collision.description: Particles die when they collide with a deflector object

use_dynamic_rotation.description: Particle rotations are affected by collisions and effectors

use_advanced_hair.description: Use full physics calculations for growing hair

invert_grid.description: Invert what is considered object and what is not

hexagonal_grid.description: Create the grid in a hexagonal pattern

create_long_hair_children.description: Calculate children that suit long hair well

distribution.description: How to distribute particles on selected element

rotation_mode.description: Particle orientation axis (does not affect Explode modifier's results)

angular_velocity_mode.description: What axis is used to change particle rotation with time

react_event.description: The event of target particles to react on

use_absolute_path_time.description: Path timing is in absolute frames

use_collection_count.description: Use object multiple times in the same collection

use_global_instance.description: Use object's global coordinates for duplication

use_rotation_instance.description: Use object's rotation for duplication (global x-axis is aligned particle rotation axis)

use_render_adaptive.description: Display steps of the particle path

use_velocity_length.description: Multiply line length by particle speed

use_strand_primitive.description: Use the strand primitive for rendering

display_method.description: How particles are displayed in viewport

display_color.description: Display additional particle data as a color

display_step.description: How many steps paths are displayed with (power of 2)

render_step.description: How many steps paths are rendered with (power of 2)

adaptive_angle.description: How many degrees path has to curve to make another render segment

adaptive_pixel.description: How many pixels path has to cover to make another render segment

display_percentage.description: Percentage of particles to display in 3D view

material.description: Index of material slot used for rendering particles

material_slot.description: Material slot used for rendering particles

integrator.description: Algorithm used to calculate physics, from the fastest to the most stable and accurate: Midpoint, Euler, Verlet, RK4

kink.description: Type of periodic offset on the path

kink_axis.description: Which axis to use for offset

color_maximum.description: Maximum length of the particle color vector

frame_start.description: Frame number to start emitting particles

frame_end.description: Frame number to stop emitting particles

lifetime_random.description: Give the particle life a random variation

time_tweak.description: A multiplier for physics timestep (1.0 means one frame = 1/25 seconds)

timestep.description: The simulation timestep per frame (seconds per frame)

use_adaptive_subframes.description: Automatically set the number of subframes

subframes.description: Subframes to simulate for improved stability and finer granularity simulations (dt = timestep / (subframes + 1))

courant_target.description: The relative distance a particle can move before requiring more subframes (target Courant number); 0.01 to 0.3 is the recommended range

jitter_factor.description: Amount of jitter applied to the sampling

grid_resolution.description: The resolution of the particle grid

grid_random.description: Add random offset to the grid locations

effector_amount.description: How many particles are effectors (0 is all particles)

normal_factor.description: Let the surface normal give the particle a starting velocity

object_factor.description: Let the object give the particle a starting velocity

factor_random.description: Give the starting velocity a random variation

particle_factor.description: Let the target particle give the particle a starting velocity

tangent_factor.description: Let the surface tangent give the particle a starting velocity

reactor_factor.description: Let the vector away from the target particle's location give the particle a starting velocity

object_align_factor.description: Let the emitter object orientation give the particle a starting velocity

angular_velocity_factor.description: Angular velocity amount (in radians per second)

phase_factor.description: Rotation around the chosen orientation axis

phase_factor_random.description: Randomize rotation around the chosen orientation axis

size_random.description: Give the particle size a random variation

brownian_factor.description: Amount of random, erratic particle movement

length_random.description: Give path length a random variation

rendered_child_count.description: Number of children per parent for rendering

child_size.description: A multiplier for the child particle size

child_size_random.description: Random variation to the size of the child particles

use_clump_curve.description: Use a curve to define clump tapering

use_clump_noise.description: Create random clumps around the parent

kink_amplitude_clump.description: How much clump affects kink amplitude

kink_frequency.description: The frequency of the offset (1/total length)

kink_shape.description: Adjust the offset to the beginning/end

kink_extra_steps.description: Extra steps for resolution of special kink features

roughness_2_threshold.description: Amount of particles left untouched by random roughness

use_roughness_curve.description: Use a curve to define roughness

child_length_threshold.description: Amount of particles left untouched by child path length

child_parting_factor.description: Create parting in the children based on parent strands

child_parting_min.description: Minimum root to tip angle (tip distance/root distance for long hair)

child_parting_max.description: Maximum root to tip angle (tip distance/root distance for long hair)

keyed_loops.description: Number of times the keys are looped

use_modifier_stack.description: Emit particles from mesh with modifiers applied (must use same subdivision surface level for viewport and render for correct results)

instance_collection.description: Show objects in this collection in place of particles

instance_weights.description: Weights for all of the objects in the instance collection

instance_object.description: Show this object in place of particles

twist.description: Number of turns around parent along the strand

use_twist_curve.description: Use a curve to define twist

root_radius.description: Strand diameter width at the root

tip_radius.description: Strand diameter width at the tip

particles.description: Particles generated by the particle system

child_particles.description: Child particles generated by the particle system

seed.description: Offset in the random number table, to get a different randomized result

child_seed.description: Offset in the random number table for child particles, to get a different randomized result

is_global_hair.description: Hair keys are in global coordinate space

use_hair_dynamics.description: Enable hair dynamics using cloth simulation

reactor_target_object.description: For reactor systems, the object that has the target particle system (empty if same object)

reactor_target_particle_system.description: For reactor systems, index of particle system on the target object

invert_vertex_group_density.description: Negate the effect of the density vertex group

invert_vertex_group_velocity.description: Negate the effect of the velocity vertex group

invert_vertex_group_length.description: Negate the effect of the length vertex group

invert_vertex_group_clump.description: Negate the effect of the clump vertex group

invert_vertex_group_kink.description: Negate the effect of the kink vertex group

invert_vertex_group_roughness_1.description: Negate the effect of the roughness 1 vertex group

invert_vertex_group_roughness_2.description: Negate the effect of the roughness 2 vertex group

vertex_group_roughness_end.description: Vertex group to control roughness end

invert_vertex_group_roughness_end.description: Negate the effect of the roughness end vertex group

invert_vertex_group_size.description: Negate the effect of the size vertex group

invert_vertex_group_tangent.description: Negate the effect of the tangent vertex group

invert_vertex_group_rotation.description: Negate the effect of the rotation vertex group

invert_vertex_group_field.description: Negate the effect of the field vertex group

invert_vertex_group_twist.description: Negate the effect of the twist vertex group

has_multiple_caches.description: Particle system has multiple point caches

parent.description: Use this object's coordinate system instead of global coordinate system

is_editable.description: Particle system can be edited in particle mode

is_edited.description: Particle system has been edited in particle mode

dt_frac.description: The current simulation time step size, as a fraction of a frame

frame_start.description: Frame on which the simulation starts

frame_end.description: Frame on which the simulation stops

frame_step.description: Number of frames between cached frames

use_disk_cache.description: Save cache files to disk (.blend file must be saved first)

is_frame_skip.description: Some frames were skipped while baking/saving that cache

use_external.description: Read cache from an external location

use_library_path.description: Use this file's path for the disk cache when library linked into another file (for local bakes per scene file, disable this option)
